title: Elephants

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Elephant
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Elephants are the biggest land animals. They have big ears and a very long nose. The long nose is called a trunk. An elephant uses its trunk to pick up food.
Elephants live in families. They "talk" to each other with very low sounds. People often cannot hear these sounds, but elephants can hear them from far away.
A baby elephant stays inside its mother for 20 to 22 months. No other land animal takes so long. Elephants can live for about 70 years.
